verdicts.reason: A keeps the ram skull as a strong full-width hero with the yellow bar across it, but the quote is forced into a long column with odd line breaks: 'to' sits alone on its own line and 'men.' and 'the weak.' wrap awkwardly. The attribution is indented off the text's left edge and crammed against the bottom of the canvas. B has the same broken wrapping and the same orphaned 'to'. It also shrinks the ram into a small top-left thumbnail with the yellow bar cut short, so the hero image becomes trivial and the top-right corner is left empty.
